label: ZimaBoard 832 single-board server
description: Credit-card-sized x86 single-board server with Intel Celeron N3450, two gigabit Ethernet ports and no wireless, plus a PCIe x4 slot for an add-in NIC.
notes: Dual 1G (both gigabit, not 2.5G) and no Wi-Fi at all. The exposed PCIe x4 slot is usually populated with a 2.5G card in router builds - add eth2 at 2.5G in the lab if that card is modelled; the slot itself is not a port.
